# odinex_firewall_attachment (Resource)

Applies a firewall to servers and label selectors. The ID is the firewall ID. Do not use `apply_to` blocks on the same `odinex_firewall`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_firewall_attachment" "web" {
  firewall_id     = odinex_firewall.web.id
  server_ids      = [odinex_server.web.id]
  label_selectors = ["role=web"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_id` (Number) ID of the firewall.

### Optional

- `label_selectors` (Set of String) Label selectors whose servers get the firewall.
- `server_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of servers to apply the firewall to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the firewall ID.
terraform import odinex_firewall_attachment.web 5
```
